feasibility_reasoning:
Sub-items (a), (b), (c) and (e) can work, but each needs files or conditions the change does not list. Sub-item (d) is mostly refuted by the code.

(d) settings boot projection. The simulation drops 9 keys (trim-sim.mjs:66-68). Three of them are read during the first render:
- theme_design: ThemeDesignStyle.tsx:63-72.
- font_sizes: ThemeFontSizesStyle.tsx:32-38. For both of these, a missing key changes the input hash, so useDeferredStyleCss.ts:52-69 regenerates the CSS from undefined after hydration (the F29a class of bug).
- seo: routes/index.tsx:356,401 builds the home h1 through homeHeadingSource.ts:31-35, so dropping it is a hydration text mismatch.

Other keys cannot be dropped either:
- key_takeaways and discussion are read on post routes, so a union boot set keeps them.
- auth_branding is read directly from the bulk cache, not through useSiteSetting: useAuth.tsx:409-411 (logout redirect) and useAuthSettings.ts:18-27 (initialData). Logged-in users would lose the configured logout and sign-in redirect, and an SSR key-read recorder cannot see event-time reads.
- About 40 non-admin files read siteSettingsQueryOptions directly, beyond the 12 useSiteSetting call sites.
- check:ssr-budgets: dehydrationWritesPerLoader is 11 and __root.tsx measures exactly 11 (ssrBudgets.ts:152), so the marker cannot be an extra setQueryData.

(e) Global colors and design tokens must still be fetched on the server. __root.tsx:603-611 documents that SSR needs them. The exclusion needs:
- a shouldDehydrateQuery filter in src/router.tsx:67 (not listed), keeping the status === "success" literal that the gate checks;
- DesignTokensStyle.tsx:47-53 to stop coalescing undefined to EMPTY;
- gating of useFontScale (useFontScale.ts:18-27), which is not warmed and refetches the row. Its arrival would otherwise regenerate the CSS with EMPTY colors.
This overlaps H2 (same cause), so the two are alternatives. The "-2 PostgREST" claim is at most 1 request + 1 preflight (one deduped fetchSiteDesignTokensRow, designTokens.ts:79-104), and (a)'s idle prefetch adds a serverFn GET back.

(a) The menu projection is fine: it can project from the same edgeTtlCache entry, so the purge (menu.functions.ts:250) and the ssrCache durable/L2 keys stay valid. The top-level-only split has conditions:
- has_children must respect filterMenuItemsForViewer visibility (SiteMenu.tsx:552-553), because hasPanel/panelKindFor depend on children (siteMenu.ts:101-109).
- The lazy drawer's MobileItem renders children on open, so the idle prefetch is mandatory.
- The HMR guard (__root.tsx:884-893) and prefetch.ts:220,457 must move to the new key, and 10 test files need updates.
- A lang key causes a skeleton on soft language switch.

(b) The post-list, slider and rated-list keys already contain lang. Fallbacks must match each consumer (PostListView.tsx:269-277 has no excerpt fallback). Adding lang to the ticker key causes ticker collapse and CLS on a soft language switch unless keepPreviousData is used.

(c) Feasible, as long as the full key stays for the popup and for registrationFields.ts:67 (popup_fields).
blocking_issues: (d) drops keys read in the first render: theme_design/font_sizes (ThemeDesignStyle.tsx:63, ThemeFontSizesStyle.tsx:32; useDeferredStyleCss regenerates CSS from undefined) and seo (home h1 via routes/index.tsx:401, a hydration mismatch); the recorder gate would put them back, so the claimed 1.58 KB gz is about 0.1-0.45 KB

(d) auth_branding is read by direct bulk-cache readers that bypass useSiteSetting (useAuth.tsx:409 logout redirect, useAuthSettings.ts:18-27 initialData); this regresses logged-in flows and an SSR key recorder cannot catch it
(d) the partial marker must not add a cache write: __root.tsx is at dehydrationWritesPerLoader 11/11 (ssrBudgets.ts:152)

(e) 'not prefetched' breaks the SSR theme (__root.tsx:603-611); it must be fetch-but-not-dehydrate, which needs src/router.tsx:67 shouldDehydrateQuery (not in the file list) plus DesignTokensStyle undefined handling

(e) useFontScale still refetches the design-token row after hydration; its arrival regenerates DesignTokensStyle with EMPTY tokens/globals unless it is also gated; this is the same cause as hydration H2, so pick one owner
(a) the top-level-only split needs has_children computed after visibility filtering, an idle prefetch for the lazy mobile drawer, and an updated HMR guard key at __root.tsx:884-893
(b) adding lang to the ticker key collapses the ticker on a soft language switch (CLS) unless keepPreviousData is used
effect_reasoning:
Bytes. The claimed -10.8 KB gz (25930 to 15111 B) includes steps that are not HW-3: internPosts (HW-3h), relUrls (HW-5), builderLocale (HW-3f) and seoLoader.
- HW-3 (a)-(e): 1642+1280+1796+1578+713+2627 = 9636 B gz.
- With (d) corrected (1578 to about 300 B): about 8.4 KB gz, about -50 KB raw.
- Fixture: about 3.0 KB gz instead of 3.8 KB.

FCP/LCP: 0 ms. HWF-5 measured no movement for a -32 KB gz document cut, and the P0 to P1 state trim alone gave FCP 1380-1449 vs 1386-1439. Structurally, with an initial cwnd of about 14.6 KB, delivery per RTT round is cumulative 14.6/43.8/102 KB. Both 89 KB and 81 KB need 3 rounds, and the document is not the long pole against the 79 KB CSS and the boot JS.

TBT today: 0. In the PSI mobile trace every document long task (1581/98, 1739/51, 1831/96, 1958/89 ms) comes before FCP at 3494 ms.

TBT after boot-js C3 (FCP about 1.4 s): those tasks enter the window with an excess of 48+1+46+39 = 134 ms.
- The claim "barrier eval about 140 ms at 4x" is refuted. bootup-time shows the document URL at 53 ms scripting plus 19 ms parse/compile in total, at 4x, for all inline scripts.
- Halving the barrier saves about 20-25 ms; HTML tokenizing saves about 50/569 x 144 ms parseHTML = 13 ms.
- That is about -35 ms CPU and about -15 to -35 ms TBT, since the tasks stay above 50 ms. This matches the no-JS P0 to P1 result: main thread -62 ms, TBT median 103 to 86 ms.
- On the mobile TBT curve (p10 200, median 600, sigma 0.858), the score moves about 0.029 per 30 ms near 200 ms, times a weight of 0.3, which is about +0.9 points per 30 ms.

Desktop: PSI TBT is already 0, so 0 points.

Post-hydration requests: net about 0. (e) removes at most 1 request + 1 preflight, and only with font-scale gating; the menu idle prefetch adds one back. The style-swap TBT win belongs to H2 and must not be double-counted.

The what-if was not run. An HTML-only transform of $tsr without matching query functions contaminates hydration, and A/A TBT noise of up to ±464 ms cannot resolve an effect of -15 to -35 ms.

better_alternative: Ship the low-risk subset: (a) public menu projection without the children split, (c) newsletter inline projection, (b) locale projection with keepPreviousData on the ticker key, and (e) folded into hydration H2 under one owner. That is 1642+1280+2627+713, about 6.3 KB gz, roughly 75% of the corrected bytes. Drop (d), or limit it to the 3 keys nothing reads (menu_primary, permalinks, media). The top-level-only menu split adds only about 1.8 KB gz at medium risk. Book HW-3 as document weight and TBT hygiene that pays only after boot-js, not as score points today.
